tasks.label: MyNutri Inspect Port 3000
args: const cp=require("node:child_process"); for(const [cmd,args] of [["ps",["-eo","pid,ppid,args"]],["ss",["-ltnp"]]]){const r=cp.spawnSync(cmd,args,{encoding:"utf8"}); if(r.status!==0){console.log(cmd+" unavailable");continue;} const lines=(r.stdout||"").split("\n"); const found=cmd==="ps"?lines.filter(x=>/next (dev|start)|next-server/.test(x)&&!x.includes("Inspect Port")):lines.filter(x=>/:3000\\b|:3000/.test(x)); console.log("$ "+cmd+" "+args.join(" ")); console.log(found.join("\n")||"No matching process/listener");}

tasks.label: Verify MyNutri Port Released
args:
const cp=require("node:child_process"); const ps=cp.spawnSync("ps",["-eo","pid,args"],{encoding:"utf8"}).stdout||""; console.log(ps.split("
").filter(x=>/next (dev|start)|next-server/.test(x)&&!x.includes("Verify MyNutri")).join("
")||"No Next server process"); const port=cp.spawnSync("ss",["-ltn"],{encoding:"utf8"}).stdout||""; const line=port.split("
").find(x=>x.includes(":3000")); console.log(line||"Port 3000 is released"); if(line)process.exitCode=1;

tasks.label: MyNutri Git Safety Check
args: const cp=require("node:child_process"); for(const args of [["status","--short"],["check-ignore","--quiet","--",".env.local"],["branch","--show-current"]]){const r=cp.spawnSync("git",args,{encoding:"utf8"});console.log("$ git "+args.join(" ")); if(args[0]==="check-ignore")console.log(r.status===0?".env.local ignored":".env.local is NOT ignored");else console.log((r.stdout||"").trimEnd()||"(no output)"); if(r.status!==0&&args[0]!=="status")process.exitCode=1;}

tasks.label: Start MyNutri Dev Server Password Reload
Verify Updated Local App Password
args: const {loadEnvConfig}=require("@next/env");loadEnvConfig(process.cwd());const base="http://127.0.0.1:3000";const run=async()=>{const password=process.env.APP_PASSWORD;if(!password)throw Error("APP_PASSWORD unavailable");const wrong=await fetch(base+"/api/auth/login",{method:"POST",headers:{"content-type":"application/json","x-forwarded-for":"192.0.2.210"},body:JSON.stringify({password:"not-the-configured-password"})});console.log("incorrect-password login HTTP",wrong.status);if(wrong.status!==401)throw Error("incorrect password did not fail");const response=await fetch(base+"/api/auth/login",{method:"POST",headers:{"content-type":"application/json","x-forwarded-for":"192.0.2.211"},body:JSON.stringify({password})});console.log("configured-password login HTTP",response.status);if(response.status!==200)throw Error("configured password did not authenticate");const cookie=response.headers.get("set-cookie")?.split(";")[0];if(!cookie)throw Error("session cookie missing");const dashboard=await fetch(base+"/api/dashboard",{headers:{cookie}});const data=await dashboard.json();console.log("authenticated dashboard HTTP",dashboard.status,"profile",Boolean(data.profile),"totals",Boolean(data.totals));if(dashboard.status!==200||!data.profile||!data.totals)throw Error("authenticated dashboard failed");};run().catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exitCode=1})

args: const cp=require("node:child_process");for(const a of [["status","--short"],["diff","--check"],["check-ignore","--quiet","--",".env.local"]]){const r=cp.spawnSync("git",a,{encoding:"utf8"});console.log("$ git "+a.join(" "));if(a[0]==="check-ignore")console.log(r.status===0?".env.local ignored":".env.local NOT ignored");else console.log((r.stdout||"").trimEnd()||"(no diff errors)");if(r.status!==0&&a[0]!=="status")process.exitCode=1;}
